title.ru: Герундий или инфинитив: enjoy doing, want to do
title.en: Gerund or infinitive: enjoy doing, want to do
title.es: Gerundio o infinitivo: enjoy doing, want to do

text.ru: Одни глаголы требуют -ing: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, keep, suggest; другие — to + V: want, decide, plan, hope, need, would like. После предлога всегда -ing: good at cooking, before leaving. Особый случай — stop: stop smoking — «бросить курить», stop to smoke — «остановиться, чтобы покурить». like, love, start можно и так, и так.
text.en: Some verbs take -ing (enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, keep, suggest), others to + V (want, decide, plan, hope, need, would like). After prepositions always -ing. stop smoking ≠ stop to smoke. like, love, start take both.
text.es: -ing tras enjoy, finish, mind; to + verbo tras want, decide, plan. Tras preposición: -ing.

rule.formula: enjoy / finish / mind / stop + V-ing · want / decide / plan / need + to V

bridge.formula: infinitivo: quiero aprender, me gusta cocinar

examples.es: Me gusta cocinar. Quiere aprender español.
